rules.description: fbguard - spazio URL separato per scraper Meta/Facebook
rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "meta" and not http.request.uri.path contains "/__fbguard" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".xml" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".txt" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".jpeg" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".jpg" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".webp" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".png" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".gif") or (http.user_agent contains "facebook" and not http.request.uri.path contains "/__fbguard" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".xml" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".txt" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".jpeg" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".jpg" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".webp" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".png" and not http.request.uri.path contains ".gif")
